title: Jarren Garcia sings “Jopay” with the Songbayanang Baristas | Everybody Sing
summary: Joining the “Singko Blanko” of “Everybody, Sing!," Jarren Garcia helped the Songbayanang Baristas take home an initial prize of ₱40,000, earning 2 additional seconds for the jackpot clock.
